plan_sections.DM-01: Create harness_labs/observability/graph_metrics.py: a pure rollup that aggregates a PlanGraph catalog record, graph detail, and children's cumulative FeatureRun detail metrics into graph-level totals (tokens with cached share, tri-state cost, calls, wall time with live-elapsed semantics, busy-interval union and utilization, peak context, verification repairs, review cycles, recovery decisions, node retries, graph attempt lineage, blockers with reasons, FeatureRun count, per-FeatureRun derived stats, per-node table, model/backend/phase breakdowns), protocol plan-graph-metrics/1, with unit tests for mixed availability and retry/blocker counting.
plan_sections.DM-02: Project human-readable names through the catalog: node objective in run_catalog._nodes, display_name on plan-graph records (plan path stem plus attempt ordinal) and feature-run records (objective-derived with deterministic fallbacks), objective on feature-run records; extend schemas/run-catalog-snapshot.schema.json and catalog contract tests.
plan_sections.DM-03: Create the snapshot contract and builder: schemas/plangraph-metrics-snapshot.schema.json (protocol plangraph-metrics-snapshot/1 with identity, display_name, status, timing, graph_metrics, per-feature-run cumulative metrics with per-try rows, outcome attempted-vs-accomplished summary, data_quality flags, provenance), harness_labs/observability/plangraph_snapshot.py read-only builder, scripts/build_plangraph_snapshot.py idempotent atomic CLI writing to <run-root>/.plan-graph-snapshots/, and best-effort snapshot emission in scripts/run_plan_graph.py after terminal finalization that can never alter run status.
plan_sections.DM-04: Extend dashboard_server.py with GET /api/plan-graphs/<id>/metrics (DM-01 rollup for live and terminal graphs, recomputed per catalog revision), GET /api/snapshots and GET /api/snapshots/<id> (from --snapshot-root plus auto-discovered .plan-graph-snapshots dirs, with existing bounds and read-only hygiene), add --snapshot-root to scripts/run_dashboard.py, and make _merge_detail_metrics report cumulative review_cycles, verification_repairs, and findings_total across node tries in a labelled block while retaining latest-try quality and per-try rows; extend API tests.
plan_sections.DM-05: Frontend live view: GraphTotals panel beneath the canvas polling the graph metrics endpoint, an In-flight strip listing every live graph with display name, state, and elapsed time with click-to-select, display names across selectors and lists, cumulative labels on retry counters; update api.js validators and tests; rebuild dashboard/plan-graph/dist.
plan_sections.DM-06: Frontend completed viewer: Live/Completed view toggle, snapshot browser listing all snapshots with display name, status, finished date, and outcome narrative, full-snapshot rendering through the shared metric components, and a comparison table with one sortable row per snapshot across headline metrics; rebuild dashboard/plan-graph/dist.
plan_sections.DM-07: Historical reconstruction hardening and runbook: fixture-based backfill tests covering missing summary.json, zero token records, graph-with-child-token split, launcher dirs without events.jsonl, and interrupted checkpoints; write docs/observability/completed-plangraph-viewer.md (post-merge backfill and viewing commands, snapshot layout, data-quality flags) and update docs/observability/logging-and-metrics.md.

acceptance_criteria.AC-DM01-1: A rollup over synthetic children with full data reports exact totals for tokens, cost, calls, wall, busy, utilization, peak, retries, recoveries, blockers, FeatureRun count, and per-FeatureRun derived stats.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM01-2: Any child with unavailable cost or missing monotonic spans degrades the corresponding aggregate to the documented tri-state instead of zero, with a reason string.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM01-3: Live graphs report elapsed wall time from checkpoint started_at; terminal graphs report summary.json wall clock.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM02-1: Catalog plan-graph records carry a deterministic display_name derived from the plan path and attempt ordinal; feature-run records carry display_name and objective; node projections carry objective.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM02-2: Records lacking source prose fall back deterministically (objective to node_id to run_id) and still validate against the extended run-catalog-snapshot schema.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM03-1: Building a snapshot for a terminal fixture graph produces a document that validates against the new schema and matches the live rollup's numbers for the same fixture.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM03-2: The CLI is idempotent, writes atomically, refuses non-terminal graphs by default, and never writes inside run directories.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM03-3: After a terminal PlanGraph run through the runner script a snapshot exists for the attempt; a snapshot-write failure leaves run status and journals untouched and is reported as a warning.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM03-4: The outcome block reports per-node objective, status, criteria satisfied/total, and non-success evidence reasons, plus graph-level attempted/succeeded/blocked/failed counts and a narrative string.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM04-1: /api/plan-graphs/<id>/metrics serves the DM-01 rollup for both live and terminal graphs and recomputes only when the catalog revision changes.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM04-2: /api/snapshots lists snapshots from configured roots and auto-discovered snapshot dirs with headline metrics; /api/snapshots/<id> returns schema-valid full documents; malformed snapshot files yield diagnostics without failing healthy listings.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM04-3: For a node with multiple tries the FeatureRun detail response reports cumulative retry, review, and findings counters across tries alongside latest-try quality and per-try rows, covered by API tests.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM05-1: With multiple live graphs in the catalog the In-flight strip lists all of them and switches selection without a reload; new in-flight graphs appear within one polling interval.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM05-2: The totals panel renders every DM-01 headline metric with explicit unavailable or estimated states and cumulative labelling, and updates while the graph is running.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM05-3: npm --prefix dashboard/plan-graph run verify passes and the committed dist build reflects the source changes.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM06-1: The completed viewer lists every snapshot the API serves and renders a selected snapshot's graph totals, per-node metrics, and outcome summary as in a live run, from the snapshot document alone.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM06-2: The comparison table shows one row per snapshot with headline metric columns and sorts ascending or descending by any column, placing data-quality-degraded values last.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM06-3: npm --prefix dashboard/plan-graph run verify passes and the committed dist build reflects the source changes.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM07-1: Backfill over a fixture corpus reproducing each historical degradation yields schema-valid snapshots with correct data_quality flags and derived wall times, and skips launcher-style dirs with a diagnostic instead of failing the corpus.
acceptance_criteria.AC-DM07-2: The runbook documents the exact post-merge operator commands to reconstruct all prior completed PlanGraphs and view them, and logging-and-metrics.md documents the snapshot artifact and its protocol.

runs.objective: Implement the PlanGraph-level metrics rollup module aggregating child FeatureRun metrics into graph totals with tri-state availability.
Project human-readable display names and objectives into run catalog records and extend the catalog snapshot schema.
Define the plangraph metrics snapshot contract and implement the read-only builder, offline CLI, and best-effort completion emission.
Expose graph rollup and snapshot endpoints on the dashboard server and make retry-related quality counters cumulative across node tries.
Add the live PlanGraph totals panel, in-flight graph strip, human-readable names, and cumulative retry labelling to the dashboard UI.
Build the completed-PlanGraph viewer with snapshot browsing, snapshot rendering through shared components, and the sortable cross-graph comparison table.
Harden snapshot reconstruction against the historical run corpus and document the backfill and viewing runbook.
